patch.summary: GitLab cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: GitLab pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: GitLab plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: log management, source control and repos, CI/CD and automation · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Ultimate
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: GitLab cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price GitLab against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (log management, source control and repos, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Paid SaaS is annual — no month-to-month Premium. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want git + CI + security in one licence requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Paid SaaS is annual — no month-to-month Premium
Side-by-side cost with GitHub on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Paid SaaS is annual — no month-to-month Premium

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Ultimate security suite is quote-gated on the current page

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not GitHub Copilot; GitLab Duo/AI is a platform feature, not the ai-code entity

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: CI minute overages on Free/low tiers

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs GitLab on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for GitLab alongside category cost modelling.
